[Story notes. These are facts already true in this story. Write the reply so that they stay true, and let the people in the scene act from what they want and what they know. Retain concrete facts, actions, choices, relevant relationships and consequences. Express them in plain affirmative language. Quote exact wording when it matters to the story or a structured evidence field requires it.
The story so far:
- The road to Crossroads (Blossomtide 14 to 18, 348): Hale led fifty riders of the Vanguard from Elerian Keep toward Crossroads Keep. Edren packed waterskins and lost one at Aldermarch. Brannic reset Night's foreshoe. At the Broken Spur, Tobin reported that Lord Darius doubled the toll at Valen Ford, and Jory reported riders in the Northwood. Hale paid the toll from Aldric's purse. The riders proved to be a Crossroads patrol. Marten cut his arm and Orren stitched it. Settled: The Northwood riders were an escort from Lord Darius.]
